title: Pancasila-Dilemmas: Evaluating Large Language Models on Indonesian Human Value Dilemmas Grounded in Pancasila

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on a multiple-choice dataset (Pancasila-Dilemmas) of daily life dilemmas grounded in Indonesian cultural and national values, measuring alignment with diverse human judgments using Probabilistic Match Score (PMS) and Max-Vote Agreement Score (MVAS).
